MissingComponentException: There is no 'CanvasRenderer' attached to the "Delivered contacts and personal route" game object, but a script is trying to access it.
You probably need to add a CanvasRenderer to the game object "Delivered contacts and personal route". Or your script needs to check if the component is attached before using it.
